title: Scheduler stops dispatching workload after a release
description: Our Kubernetes-based orchestration cluster was upgraded from 2.2 to 2.3. Scheduled jobs initially execute but later remain queued. Restarting the scheduler restores service temporarily.

title: Scheduler liveness warnings under memory pressure
description: The scheduler process is still present, but the interface reports that its last heartbeat is several hours old. New tasks are not dispatched. Memory consumption rises before the incident.

title: Metadata database CPU saturation after rollout
description: A cluster with thousands of workflows and multiple schedulers has sharply increased MySQL CPU usage after an Airflow release. Repeated updates during workflow parsing appear to scan large portions of the DAG table.

title: Migration fails while persisting workflow definitions
description: During a release upgrade the metadata migration emits a duplicate primary key error for serialized workflow records. Subsequent SQLAlchemy operations report that the transaction needs rollback.

title: Work remains scheduled despite healthy initial execution
description: After restarting a production Kubernetes scheduler, jobs execute for about an hour. Later task instances remain scheduled rather than queued. Restart restores operation for a limited time.

title: Worker startup rejects broker configuration
description: A Celery deployment uses several Redis Sentinel endpoints for high availability. Workers fail during startup when the broker setting contains multiple addresses separated by semicolons; the parser reports an invalid port.

title: Queued Kubernetes workload has no execution logs
description: A task is waiting for its pod to start and downstream work cannot proceed. Cluster capacity or missing mounted resources may prevent the pod entering Running. Operators cannot see useful task logs in the Airflow interface.

title: Removed workflow still appears in the interface
description: A workflow definition was deleted from the DAG directory. The command-line listing no longer includes it, yet the web interface and PostgreSQL metadata continue to show it days later.

title: Parser memory increases during idle periods
description: In an Airflow 3 deployment the DAG-processing service steadily consumes more resident memory even with example workflows and little activity. Restarts temporarily reset usage.

title: Typed storage path becomes plain text between tasks
description: After a patch upgrade a downstream task receives a string instead of the storage-path object nested inside a Pydantic model returned by an upstream task.

title: Task extra-link endpoint fails when reading shared output
description: A custom UI link plugin reads task output via the SDK. The API returns an import error involving task-runner communications, but links render normally when the output lookup is removed.

title: Successful worker execution recorded as failure
description: Following an upgrade to Airflow 2.0, a worker finishes normally but the scheduler stalls and subsequently records the task run as failed. Database monitoring shows no corresponding database deadlock.
